name: localport-manager
description: Apple-inspired desktop widget and control center for Windows local development ports

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && pnpm compile:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.compile:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'dist-electron/electron/services/native-scripts', 'dist-electron/assets' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item -Force 'electron/services/native-scripts/*' 'dist-electron/electron/services/native-scripts/'; Copy-Item -Force 'assets/*' 'dist-electron/assets/'"

author: Antigravity
